pages.text: Bestiary entries light up in three steps:$(li)$(l)Seen$(): it is within 24 blocks and in sight$(li)$(l)Fought$(): you (or your units or powers) hurt it, or it hurts you$(li)$(l)Defeated$(): the kill counts as yours; trial bosses count every participant; summoning counts as taming$(br2)Unseen entries stay locked. What you learn stays with you even if the book is lost.

$(l)Travellers' tales$():$(li)Centaurs camp in woodland meadows and windswept forests$(li)Noisy flocks roost on dead trees in the Lernaean marshes$(li)Shrill laughter echoes off the cliffs of the stormy highlands and the coast$(li)Something big walks sideways along marshes and stony shores

$(li)By old oaks in flower forests and meadows, a spirit guards the grove$(li)In collapsed temples the statues turn their heads$(li)Deep in the Labyrinth of Knossos lives a bull-headed monster$(li)Some say a priest will trade you a token for a winged horse
